model_reply_normalization.scope: Apply to every model reply parsed as JSON, including candidate proposals and route decisions.
model_reply_normalization.allowed: Accept plain JSON or remove exactly one Markdown code fence that covers the entire trimmed reply, with language tag json (case-insensitive) or no language tag. The opening and closing fences must each be on their own line.
model_reply_normalization.forbidden: Do not extract JSON from prose, remove partial or nested fences, repair JSON syntax, add or drop keys, synthesize values, or clip coordinates.
model_reply_normalization.audit: Preserve the untouched raw response. Record normalization_type (none or full_json_fence), raw_sha256, normalized_sha256, and the normalized text or its path before schema validation.

candidate_field_contract.candidate_id: integer or short string unique within the case
candidate_field_contract.bbox_xyxy_640: four finite numbers [x1,y1,x2,y2] in the original 640x640 image; 0<=x1<x2<=640 and 0<=y1<y2<=640
candidate_field_contract.type: one of the listed type enums
candidate_field_contract.description: short visible description grounded in the image
candidate_field_contract.hypothesized_role: navigation-relevant role hypothesis, not a gold label
candidate_field_contract.visibility: one of the listed visibility enums
candidate_field_contract.uncertainty: required numeric self-report in [0,1]; 0 means low uncertainty and 1 means high uncertainty; not calibrated

candidate_proposal.empty_candidate_rule: If no clear candidate is visible, emit candidates=[] and parse_status=no_clear_candidate; do not invent a dummy box.
candidate_proposal.format_retry_policy: After the permitted full-fence normalization, retry once on the same image if JSON syntax or candidate schema validation fails, including missing fields, extra keys, or out-of-range coordinates. Preserve both raw responses and their normalization metadata. A normalized reply that passes the existing schema needs no retry. Never repair JSON, synthesize uncertainty, or clip coordinates.
candidate_proposal.coordinate_contract: bbox is [x1,y1,x2,y2] in the original 640x640 image; integers or finite numbers; 0<=x1<x2<=640 and 0<=y1<y2<=640

route_decision.chosen_edge_id: anonymous option id supplied by the scorer; never a panoid
route_decision.uncertain: boolean; self-report only and not a calibrated probability
route_decision.evidence_candidates: zero or more candidate_id values from a separately frozen proposal file
